description: Animates one clip property. property: opacity | volume | positionX | positionY | scaleX | scaleY | rotationDeg | pitch | yaw | anchorX | anchorY | cropLeft | cropTop | cropRight | cropBottom | cropSoftness. Keyframes are stamped in SOURCE frames (frames into the media, i.e. timelineFrame - startFrame + trimStartFrame), so they survive moves and trims. action 'set' (default) upserts the given keyframes; 'remove' deletes at the given frames; 'clear' removes the property's animation (or ALL animation when property is omitted). easing is how the value LEAVES a keyframe: linear | hold | smooth.

atSourceFrames.description: For 'remove': source frames whose keyframes to delete.

effectId.description: Animate an EFFECT param instead of a clip property: the effect instance id (from manage_effects add / get_timeline). Use with `param`; `property` is then ignored.

keyframes.description: For 'set': keyframes to add or replace.

param.description: The effect param key to animate (e.g. 'exposure').

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: set_keyframes
